epics.title: Full Stack Orchestration
epics.jtbd: When receiving the delivered system, I want to be able to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can launch and verify the product end-to-end.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Environment consistency rate across developer instances
requirements: R1: The runtime contract (docs/architecture/adr-002-runtime-contract.md) must explicitly declare postgresql as the datastore engine.
R2: The application configuration (src/main/resources/application.properties) and runtime artifacts must use postgresql by default, matching the runtime contract.

slices.title: Unify datastore configuration to postgresql
slices.jtbd: When implementing the unified datastore declaration for this epic, I want to establish the runtime contract as the single source of truth for postgresql and align all artifacts, so that the delivered system reliably starts with consistent data engines across all environments.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the runtime contract docs/architecture/adr-002-runtime-contract.md and application.properties
When the system artifacts are parsed and the application starts
Then the contract must declare postgresql and the application must connect to postgresql instead of h2
